 A Veterans Day ceremony will begin promptly at 11 a.m. Wednesday, Nov. 11, at the veterans memorial in front of the St. Croix County Government Center in Hudson. 
 Members of Hudson VFW Memorial Post 2115 and American Legion Post 50 are sponsoring the ceremony. 
 Following the ceremony, the posts will serve refreshments in the Government Center’s Hudson and North Hudson rooms, GC-2800 and GC-2801.
